name: Background microphone transcription
prompt: Run the background-transcription.microphone-background-audio task using the bundled 10-second archival speech fixture. The workflow must start Device mic recording, background the app, inject the fixture through the virtual microphone, and foreground the app after delivery completes.

assertions: The audio provider completed delivery to the selected virtual device.
The app was moved to the background before audio delivery and returned to the foreground afterward.
The final durable transcription result is completed, identifies device_microphone input, records that the app was backgrounded, and contains a non-empty transcript.
